body.title: Add and publish the fixed qualification budget policy
body.summary: Add proposed src/installer/qualification-time-budgets.mjs and src/installer/qualification-time-budgets.d.mts. Select normal/slow-vm once at import, deeply freeze role values, validate the enum before admission, and preserve every normal numeric value. Update copy-assets.mjs to copy and byte-verify the MJS beside compiled consumers; exercise installed and bundled imports through existing payload publication. No application/source-builder dependencies in the policy.
acceptanceChecks: Absent/normal and slow-vm snapshots match the LLD role table exactly; slow-vm includes 40min commands,4h worker/manager,2h qualification build/file,5h qualification run,120s manager cleanup and5min outer cleanup.
Unknown/empty/whitespace/numeric selectors fail with qualification-profile-invalid before work; policy cannot change after import or mutation.

Copied out policy matches source bytes and imports independently; repeat actual installed/bundled consumer integration in t5 once all consumers are wired. Preserve runtime identity/wire/payload provenance rules.
